comments.body: "Star Yomibito". Well, that's the machine-based translation, at least. A new title acquired from making certain Astronomical discoveries; not sure which ones yet, but we'll see soon enough, I guess.

comments.body: Not 100% sure, but I think that means star poet. And the discoveries are the zodiac constelations.
